subject.title: fix(browser): use public ssrf runtime import in CDP proxy bypass

question: Should `registerManagedProxyBrowserCdpBypass` become part of the public `openclaw/plugin-sdk/ssrf-runtime` contract, or should the browser fix preserve the current private owner-scoped helper boundary?
rationale: Current main explicitly keeps managed proxy bypass helpers out of public Plugin SDK surface, while this PR's import path only works if that boundary changes.

options.title: Preserve Private Owner-Scoped Access
options.body: Keep the helper private and fix packaged Browser/Ollama resolution through the existing owner-scoped alias or staging path.

options.title: Approve Public SSRF Runtime Export
options.body: Move the helper into public `ssrf-runtime` only with maintainer-approved SDK/security docs, contract tests, and release context.

options.title: Use A Canonical Replacement
options.body: Close or pause this branch if maintainers choose a sibling PR or new replacement branch as the canonical repair.

recommendation.title: Preserve Private Owner-Scoped Access
recommendation.body: Keep the helper private and fix packaged Browser/Ollama resolution through the existing owner-scoped alias or staging path.

likelyOwner.reason: The current main lines for the Browser import, private helper, package export map, and owner-scoped alias all trace to this recent boundary refactor.
